description: This file defines the interface for the IIpcClient class and its accessor within the Rialto client module, including methods for obtaining IPC channels, creating blocking closures, and RPC controllers.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class for obtaining the singleton instance of IIpcClient and the associated IIpcClient object.

classes.name: IIpcClient
classes.description: Interface defining the IPC client functionalities such as obtaining channels, creating closures, and RPC controllers.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the IIpcClientAccessor.

methods.name: IIpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel created by the client.

methods.name: IIpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a blocking closure for RPC calls.

methods.name: IIpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns an RPC controller for use with RPC stubs.
